settings.title: We reach out at the right moment.

settings.editor: Timing matters as much as the right person. These are signals we watch for.
A new head of sales, IT or operations often reviews vendors in the first months.
A new office, plant or market usually means new needs and new budgets.
Hiring for key roles or launching a product shows where a company is investing.
